[b]NOTE[/b]
I am not copying [nation]Pantagruel[/nation] and the events in his nation. I just very poorly timed this event.
[spoiler=Assassination of Ayoub Tazi] 
A woman, in the capitol building of Kaaganika, herself a matcha tea for herself. She takes a few sips of the tea, before standing up and walking down the hallway, with the occasional soldier standing guard at a door and smiling at her when she walks by. This woman was Monika Tazi, the wife of the now politician Ayoub Tazi, and she was walking down the western wing of the capitol building to check on her husband.

She took a sip of her strawberry matcha tea right before hearing a loud [b][i]BANG BANG[/i][/b] from a few rooms down. She immediately spit out her tea and began running towards her husbands room. Her heart was suddenly pounding in her chest, rudely awoken by the fear that the worst had happened. 

She barged into her husbands room to find a terrifying sight. Both her husband and a soldier were lying dead on the ground, with the president still in his pajamas. She instantly winced back at the scene, however she did not lose composure. She was then met with several other guards, with a similar reaction to her at the sight of the dead president. The bedroom was quickly cleaned up and the president was dealt with in quick fashion, being rushed to the hospital, however it was too late. He had died almost immediately after being shot both in the heart and the lungs.[/spoiler]
[spoiler=Newspaper]
[b][u]BREAKING NEWS![/b][/u]
As of recent, the world leaders of Erene have been killed or overthrown. This, just yesterday, has had our dear Ayoub Tazi sent to the heavens, as he was found dead in his bedroom with a dead soldier across from him. Officials have recently told our program that Monika Tazi has taken control of the nation in Ayoubs place and will be the new president of Kaaganika. Only time will tell where she plans to bring the nation.
The news is quickly spread by the next day after Ayoubs death, however it only really reaches mainstream in Kaaganika and to a lesser extent Baladullah due to being overshadowed by Pantagruels events, the coups occurring across Erene and the conflict in Nestor-Sikirsk. [/spoiler]
[spoiler=About Monika Tazi, the new leader]
Ayoubs wife has taken power in Kaaganika due to an unfortunate assassination on Ayoub by a rebellious guard.
While rumors were spread that Monika was behind the assassination, she claims that she had nothing to do with it, and with much public attention to her and her love for her husband, most went along with it.
This idea was reinforced by a recent speech done after the assassination, where she had almost broke down on stage while talking about the death of her husband.

The public is mostly in support of the new president over Ayoub, with one hangup- she wasnt Kaaganikan. She is a 22 year old foreigner from Llyndora who Tazi had taken a liking to years ago on a trip. This made Monika look very out of place in Kaaganika, but with her relationship with Ayoub, nobody paid it any mind. They were deeply in love, and the death of Ayoub motivated her to take his place, albeit with a more modest and democratic approach to internal and external issues.
She has stated that she is determined to keep the regime intact and uphold the values of the state as well as keeping her personal problems to herself. She has also stated she has no plans of remarrying, as she wants to consolidate power in herself and build Kaaganika in her image.
[/spoiler]
I will be posting about her on a separate factbook shortly.

[i][u][b]The Road to Berlinwerk  July 4, 2025 | 8:03 PM [/b][/u]

The long black car glides silently through the winding forest path, trees standing like shadowed sentinels. Inside, Alexa sits calmly, one hand resting near the holster on his belt. Luma, beside him, gazes out the window, clutching her plush bunny. Klaus, the feline servant, drives without a word.

[b]Klaus (softly):[/b] "Berlinwerk is quiet. Hidden. The founders built it away from the world. No cameras, no cities, no judgment."

[b]Luma:[/b] "Is it safe?"

[b]Alexa:[/b]"It will be. As long as we remain ghosts."
*Cut to wide aerial view* the car enters a clearing with high walls, guarded gates, and towers rising like ancient stone teeth. Berlinwerk Palace looms in the mist, draped in vines and shadows.

[u][b]Berlinwerk Palace  Arrival Hall [/b][/u]

Massive wooden doors creak open. Inside, the air is thick with dust and history. Antique paintings. Gold chandeliers. A haunting stillness.

[b]Klaus: [/b]"I will prepare the eastern wing for Lady Luma. Your quarters remain untouched, sir."

[b]Alexa (nods):[/b] "Thank you, Klaus. And... thank you for protecting her."
Klaus offers a faint, feline smile.

[b]Klaus:[/b]"I lost a sister in the early purges. I won't lose another."

[u][b]Berlinwerk Palace, Eastern Wing  9:27 PM [/b][/u]

Luma walks through dimly lit hallways, trailing her paw along the carved wood panels. Antique portraits stare down silently. She enters her chambera room once made for royalty. A fireplace crackles to life as Klaus sets down her things.

[b]Luma:[/b] "Its so big... like a storybook."

[b]Klaus:[/b] "Every story has a beginning, dear. Make yours count."

He bows and exits.
She kneels by the window and opens it slightly. The wind howls through the trees.

[u][b]Berlinwerk Palace, Alexas Quarters  10:12 PM [/b][/u]

Alexa sits in silence, facing the fire. His S.S.E. badge lies on the table, beside a folded letter and a holopic of his sister.
Luma walks in, still holding the plush bunny. She hesitates.

[b]Luma:[/b]"Can I sit here?"

[b]Alexa:[/b]"Of course."
She sits. The fire flickers.

[b]Luma:[/b] "You were in the S.S.E., werent you?"

[b]Alexa:[/b] "I still am. Technically."

[b]Luma:[/b] "Why did you save me?"

[b]Alexa:[/b] "Because I saw myself in you. Not who I was. Who I should have been."
Long silence. The fire crackles.

[b]Luma (softly):[/b] "I miss them. My family. I can still hear them scream when I sleep."

[b]Alexa:[/b]"Then well give them a reason to stop screaming. We survive. Thats how we honor them."
She leans against him.

[u][b]Berlinwerk Palace, Hidden Cellar  Midnight [/b][/u]
Klaus unlocks a hidden door behind a wine rack. He walks through a narrow stone corridor into a secret chamber filled with files, radios, and resistance tech.
He flips on a light. A dusty map of the Oceanice Republic is pinned on the wall.

[b]Klaus (to himself):[/b] "Time to finish what they started."
He circles Berlinwerk on the map. Marks a new point, "Opal Terminal  July 28"

[b]Berlinwerk Palace  Following Morning Luma wanders through the massive palace alone. [/b]

Shes amazed, but also uneasy. Luxury fills every corner, murals, string music playing from hidden speakers, and velvet drapes.
She passes a field commander, who sneers as she walks by.

[b]Field Commander (mocking):[/b] "Someone left their pet off its leash."
Guards laugh. Before anything escalates, Klaus storms in.

[b]Klaus:[/b] "Watch your mouth, bastard."
They exchange slurs. An old rivalry flares.

Alexa arrives just in time.
[b]Alexa (firm):[/b] "Enough!"

The field commander spits in Alexas face.
[b]Field Commander:[/b]"Youre nothing but a P*ssy."

He storms off with his entourage.
Alexa sighs and takes Luma by the hand, leading her back to his quarters.

[u][b]Alexas Quarters  Morning [/b][/u]

Alexa and Luma are asleep when Klaus knocks.

[b]Klaus (urgent):[/b] "Wake up! Shes gone!"
Panic erupts. Staff, guards, even kitchen maids join the search. The palace erupts with worry.

Suddenly, the head chef bursts out of the kitchen*
[b]Chef:[/b] "Theres a damn animal eating raw chicken!"

Klaus and Alexa rush in. They find Luma sitting cross-legged, happily gnawing on a chicken leg.
Klaus and Alexa laugh, torn between relief and disbelief.
Suddenly, the field commander storms in again.

[b]Field Commander (angrily):[/b] "Whats the commotion now?!"
He sees the scene, rolls his eyes.

[b]Field Commander:[/b] "Leash your damn pet."

Alexa steps forward, pushing Klaus gently aside.
[b]Alexa (firm, voice rising):[/b] "Shes not a pet. Shes my daughter."

Silence. The room freezes.
The field commander stares, speechless.
Klaus smirks with satisfaction. The guards blink, unsure.

[u][b]Forest Path  Later [/b][/u]

Alexa and Luma walk through the quiet woods beyond Berlinwerk. The man-made lake glistens nearby.

[b]Alexa:[/b] "When I was your age, my father brought me here. My sister too. We met the last leaders before the coup."
He kneels by the lake.

[b]Alexa:[/b] "I always wanted a family. But when my father found out I loved someone outside our kind... he hanged her. Right in front of me."
Luma gasps. Her paw reaches for his hand.

[b]Alexa (choked):[/b] "I wont let him take another. Not you. Not ever. You are my child now."
She throws her arms around him. He breaks down.

[b]Luma (softly):[/b] "I love you, dad."
They hug as the wind rustles the leaves.

[u][b]Klauss Workshop, Hidden Cellar  Night [/b][/u]

Klaus files down a prototype weapon, his expression grim.
He checks a clock, 'July 28. Opal Terminal"

Suddenly, a guard knocks at the cellar entrance*

[b]Guard:[/b] "Someone's here to see you. Claims to know your past."
Klaus puts down the weapon and straightens his coat.

[b]Klaus Replay[/b]
I will be coming in a short sec.

Part 4

[spoiler=[b]Prelude[/b]]
Aduab is run through by three rivers coming from the northeast, two make a large, long island at the center of the city, with the third river cutting diagonally through it. The island is protected by walls that have remained standing since the middle ages, protecting the wealthier parts of the city, alongside its Great Mosque and the Citadel.

Sal-Baliz, with its army reduced to smoking wrecks at this point, were determined to cause as much damage as possible to the democratic infidels. From the citys underdeveloped metro, the Sal-Baliz created an extensive system of tunnels, and makeshift roof-to-roof bridges could be found all across the city. Fortified trenches separated the city into two spheres, with a third sphere being the island at the center of the city itself. Sal-Baliz would adopt a strategy which THEP nicknamed as weasel tactics - Several resistance points were set up across the city, and infantry squads armed with anti-tank weapons would rush between these points, trying to ambush the tanks and slipping away before the tanks could spot them and return fire, with normal squads suppressing the infantry, with the aforementioned system of tunnels and bridges connecting all those points.

THEP forces would soon reach Aduab and would organize an assault - The Hydronians would launch an attack from the north, while the Bobians marched from the south.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]BATTLE OF ADUAB - day 1-5[/b]]
At 6AM, the THEP air forces started an extensive bombing run of the city, focusing their attacks on points that the high command deemed to be plausible concentration of enemy forces, or heavily defensible areas. By 8AM, the ground forces advanced, under the cover of helicopters, and the Hydronians were the first to be met with intense fire from both small arms, RPGs, and heavy machine guns. The infantry hunkered down in the farmlands, taking cover behind houses and ditches - The tanks and IFVs moved forward, firing high-explosive shells and rockets aimed at the sporadic flashes of gunfire. The Bobians would get the short end of the stick, the south of the city was practically flat, devoid of any strong cover. Bobian infantry stayed behind their armored vehicles, forming massive offensive columns, and although the RPGs and HMGs would fail to properly penetrate the armor, parts such as the machine guns, the main cannons and the tracks would be chipped away until they were disabled, the neutralization of the latter essentially halting the offensive column. THEP authorized another bombing run. Jets and helicopters showered the city with rockets and bombs, with the objective of flattening the first sphere of defenses. The Bobian army advanced under the cover of the bombardment, by the time the Sal-Baliz crawled out of their holes and organized a defense, the THEP were already at the citys gates. The militia, armed with obsolete weapons and lances, were forced to charge at the armored columns by the Sal-Baliz, while the properly armed troops continued with the weasel tactics or provided suppressing fire. THEP forces were under constant attack for the whole day, advancing deeper and deeper into the city. The Bobian army reached the 2nd sphere of defenses first on Day 3, advancing under machine gun fire across the boulevards and parks of the city. Day and night, jets and helicopters roamed the skies, bombing any determined resistance points into submission.
[/spoiler]
